description: Estimate the theoretical time to transfer a file of a given size over a connection of a given speed (decimal/SI file size units, standard networking speed units where Mbps is megabits/second and MBps is megabytes/second). Pass targetSeconds instead of speed/speedUnit to run the reverse calculation: the bandwidth required to hit that target time.

fileSizeUnit.description: The unit fileSize is expressed in

speed.description: The connection speed, in speedUnit (omit and pass targetSeconds for the reverse calculation)

speedUnit.description: The unit speed is expressed in

targetSeconds.description: Target transfer time in seconds; when set, computes the required bandwidth instead of the transfer time

name: estimate_data_transfer_time
